test_cases.title: Verify successful login with valid credentials
preconditions: User is on the login page
steps: Enter a valid username in the username field
Enter a valid password in the password field
test_cases.expected_result: User is successfully redirected to the Dashboard page.

test_cases.title: Verify login fails with invalid username and valid password
preconditions: User is on the login page
steps: Enter an invalid username in the username field
Enter a valid password in the password field
test_cases.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating invalid credentials.

test_cases.title: Verify login fails with valid username and invalid password
preconditions: User is on the login page
steps: Enter a valid username in the username field
Enter an invalid password in the password field
test_cases.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating invalid credentials.

test_cases.title: Verify login fails when username field is left empty
preconditions: User is on the login page
steps: Enter a valid password in the password field
test_cases.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the username is mandatory.

test_cases.title: Verify login fails when password field is left empty
preconditions: User is on the login page
steps: Enter a valid username in the username field
test_cases.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the password is mandatory.

test_cases.title: Verify login fails when both username and password fields are left empty
preconditions: User is on the login page
test_cases.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that username and password are mandatory.
